innkeeper.ko: 지친 손님을 위해 깨끗한 방을 마련해요.

innkeeper.en: Breakfast is my favorite part of the day.
innkeeper.ko: 아침 식사 시간이 하루 중 가장 좋아요.

innkeeper.en: Some guests tell wonderful stories about distant places.
innkeeper.ko: 어떤 손님들은 먼 곳에 관한 멋진 이야기를 들려줘요.

innkeeper.en: A warm blanket makes a cold night more comfortable.
innkeeper.ko: 따뜻한 담요가 있으면 추운 밤에도 더 편안해요.

innkeeper.en: Please check your room before you leave.
I enjoy growing flowers near the entrance.
innkeeper.ko: 입구 근처에서 꽃을 기르는 걸 좋아해요.

guard.en: Please tell me if you notice a problem.
I walk around the village at the start of my shift.
guard.ko: 근무를 시작할 때 마을을 한 바퀴 돌아요.

guard.en: A clear report is more useful than a frightening rumor.
I practice with my shield when I have free time.
guard.ko: 시간이 날 때 방패를 사용하는 연습을 해요.

guard.en: Travelers often ask me where the inn is.
guard.ko: 여행자들은 여관이 어디 있는지 자주 물어요.

guard.en: Even a quiet day requires careful attention.

specialist_a.en: My work takes patience and practice.
I check my tools before starting a new task.
specialist_a.ko: 새 작업을 시작하기 전에 도구를 점검해요.

specialist_a.en: I learned a lot from my first teacher.
A small mistake can cause a bigger problem later.
specialist_a.ko: 작은 실수가 나중에 더 큰 문제를 일으킬 수 있어요.

specialist_a.en: I keep notes about the things I learn at work.
I enjoy solving problems with other people.
specialist_a.ko: 다른 사람들과 함께 문제를 해결하는 게 좋아요.

specialist_b.en: I enjoy teaching people what I know.
specialist_b.ko: 제가 아는 것을 사람들에게 가르치는 게 좋아요.

specialist_b.en: There is always something new to learn.
I try a different method when the first one fails.
specialist_b.ko: 첫 방법이 실패하면 다른 방법을 시도해요.

specialist_b.en: My best ideas often come during a walk.
specialist_b.ko: 가장 좋은 아이디어는 산책 중에 떠오를 때가 많아요.

specialist_b.en: I prefer careful work to hurried work.
Sometimes a beginner asks the most interesting question.
specialist_b.ko: 가끔 초보자가 가장 흥미로운 질문을 해요.

resident_a.en: I am saving time for a small project of my own.
resident_a.ko: 제 작은 계획을 위해 시간을 내고 있어요.

resident_a.en: I usually finish my chores before lunch.
My neighbors and I often help each other.
I would like to visit another village someday.
resident_a.ko: 언젠가 다른 마을에 가 보고 싶어요.

resident_a.en: I enjoy the quiet moments at the end of the day.
resident_a.ko: 하루가 끝날 무렵의 조용한 시간을 좋아해요.

resident_a.en: Have you met anyone interesting on your journey?

child.en: I want to learn something new today.
My friends and I like making up stories.
I found a pretty stone on my way home.
child.ko: 집에 가는 길에 예쁜 돌을 발견했어요.

child.en: I am practicing how to draw a map.
What was your favorite game when you were little?
child.ko: 어렸을 때 어떤 놀이를 가장 좋아했어요?

child.en: Someday I want to go on an adventure too.

courier.en: I check the address before I leave.
I keep letters in a dry bag when it rains.
courier.ko: 비가 오면 편지를 마른 가방에 넣어 보관해요.

courier.en: A wrong address can make a short trip much longer.
courier.ko: 주소가 틀리면 짧은 여행이 훨씬 길어질 수 있어요.

courier.en: I like meeting familiar faces along the road.
courier.ko: 길에서 익숙한 얼굴을 만나는 게 좋아요.

courier.en: I take a rest before starting a long journey.
Every letter has someone waiting for it.
courier.ko: 모든 편지에는 그 편지를 기다리는 사람이 있어요.

resident_b.en: I like hearing stories from other villages.
resident_b.ko: 다른 마을 이야기를 듣는 게 좋아요.

resident_b.en: I sometimes sit outside and watch the clouds.
I have a few books that I read again and again.
resident_b.ko: 몇 번이고 다시 읽는 책이 몇 권 있어요.

resident_b.en: I try to make something useful from old materials.
resident_b.ko: 오래된 재료로 유용한 것을 만들려고 해요.

resident_b.en: The village feels different when the seasons change.
I hope you find a good place to rest tonight.
resident_b.ko: 오늘 밤 편히 쉴 곳을 찾으면 좋겠어요.
